TOOLING BURST FL-4d — £0 ALIGNMENT: re-encode the fire and Blackwater tests that encode pre-FL-4 / pre-BL-1a values (Run C-5; conductor R-C5-120). task_id "FL-4d". NO runtime or kit change is expected; if a test reveals a genuine regression, fix the runtime and say so.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4h, T4p, T4q, T4s (all), FL-2, FL-3, FL-3b, FL-4a, FL-4b, FL-4c, BL-1a and the new row "FL-4d — alignment after FL-4 and BL-1a" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. The current specs/kits as LAW: runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/specs/blackwater_cocktail.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_A/kit.json, fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json, fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json, fire_burst_e0p_v3/kit.json, blackwater_cocktail_e3/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json (18 kits); export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (read for what the runtime NOW does); the three test files.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

THE REDS (conductor, outside suite after FL-4c, 24 red / 739 pass; the five standing oracle reds and the E3-r1 catalogue lock are NOT yours): tests/test_effect_kit.py: RaggedResidueMaterialTests.test_t4e_entry_ragged_connected_and_zero_disc_control; ContinuousResidueMaterialTests.test_entry_shape_and_shared_shard_union_and_zero_control; ProjectileArmValidationTests.test_both_arms_preserve_spec_and_quantised_primitives; ProjectileArmValidationTests.test_empty_key_arms_have_identical_kit_files_except_name; FL2FieldValidationTests.test_all_new_fields_validate_in_actual_catalogue; AntiDecalValidationTests.test_defaults_absent_and_real_fire_fields_load. tests/test_godot_import.py: RaggedResidueImportTests.test_exported_threshold_and_every_root_and_stretch_material_agree; ContinuousResidueImportTests.test_whole_canvas_texture_shared_by_every_material_and_cpu_cutoff; ProjectileTravelEmissionTests.test_node_tree_material_and_spec_driven_config; AntiDecalTraceTests.test_core_additive_contact_expanded_spent_and_residue_release; AntiDecalTraceTests.test_every_hold_frame_changes_actual_shader_uniforms; AntiDecalTraceTests.test_shimmer_residue_only_bounded_fade_and_extent_report; GroundVisibilityRegressionTests.test_flask_stays_visible_at_native_screen_extent_during_flight; FieldDesignLapEmissionTests.test_both_flasks_three_flight_ages_global_layer_alpha_and_scale; FieldDesignLapEmissionTests.test_emitted_tree_material_and_native_pool_anchors; FieldDesignLapEmissionTests.test_pool_final_24_frames_dissolve_then_scorch_and_cleanup. tests/test_vfx_picker.py: ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_empty_key_exports_byte_identically_except_kit_name; ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_headless_east_contact_range_tail_and_key_schedule.

What changed that these tests still encode: (1) FL-4a removed the painted residue for the fire burst (residue_s 0, ember_ending) and shortened the holds (expanded 12/2 f, spent 24/2 f) — tests asserting a residue phase, residue_s .6/.8, hold 3/6, a shimmer over the residue, or "residue_release" must be re-encoded to the ember ending (no painted residue after age 26; ember births; afterglow); (2) FL-4b bound new head/streak primitives (fire_head_02, fire_sheet_01) and pointed arm B's impact at fire_burst_e0p_v3 while arm A stays on _v2 — tests asserting the arms identical except name, or the old primitive hashes / extents, must be re-encoded to the CURRENT arms (state which fields differ and why: impact_binding); (3) FL-4c changed stretch and dissolve order for _v3 and added per-kit stretch fields; (4) FL-3/3b added core/boil/contact-light/shimmer-sheet fields and one shared noise texture — the "whole canvas texture shared" test now sees the _v3 kit's textures too (count per kit, not per export); (5) BL-1a re-specced Blackwater at rank 1 (flight 0.40 s / apex 42, pool 2.5 s, scorch 12 s, lick flicker) — the four Blackwater tests must derive their ages from the kit's own fields, never literals. Rule: RE-ENCODE FROM THE CURRENT SPEC/KIT FIELDS (never a literal count or age); NEVER weaken an assertion's intent; if the intent no longer applies (e.g. a residue that no longer exists) replace it with the equivalent assertion on the new mechanism and say so in the docstring; if any test exposes a genuine regression, FIX THE RUNTIME and report it.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-4d/acceptance.json): per test — old assertion → new assertion → why (one line each); the named tests green in the sandbox; 18 kits byte-identical; full catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; remaining reds NAMED (expected: the five standing oracle reds + E3-r1).
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit, any spec, fixtures/ (unless a byte lock needs the FL-1b diff rule — list it), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-4d/. export/ only if a genuine regression is found (say so). Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-4d/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-4d"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
